title: The Mermaid Mask is a perfect vacation murder mystery
summary: A point-and-click murder mystery game set in a submarine where the captain is found dead in a locked room. Players investigate using a diverse cast of colorful suspects including an author, actor, illusionist, and dream researcher, making it an ideal vacation gaming experience.
content:
The Mermaid Mask, the next point-and-click game from Tangle Tower developer SFB Games, has everything you could ask for in a great murder mystery.
It starts with a compelling setup: The captain of a submarine is found dead in a locked room, his body next to a mysterious cauldron with blood trickling across the floor. The colorful cast of suspects stationed aboard are delightful to talk to, including a grumpy author trying to draft a sequel to his hit novel, an actor playing the lead in a movie based on that novel, a young woman who puts on elaborate illusion performances, and even a man who studies dreams. zh.title: "美人鱼面具"是完美的度假谋杀悬念游戏
zh.summary: 这是一款以潜艇为背景的点击式谋杀悬念游戏，游艇船长在密闭房间内死亡。玩家通过调查包括作家、演员、魔术师和梦想研究员在内的多样化可疑人物来解开谜团，是理想的度假游戏体验。

title: After noise complaints, judge orders Waymo to stop overnight charging in Santa Monica
summary: A Santa Monica judge ordered Waymo to halt overnight charging operations following resident noise complaints about sleep disruptions. The ruling reflects growing community concerns about autonomous vehicle infrastructure impacts on residential neighborhoods.
content: Autonomous vehicle giant disturbs residents' sleep.

zh.title: 受噪音投诉，法官责令Waymo停止在圣莫尼卡进行夜间充电
zh.summary: 圣莫尼卡法官在居民因睡眠中断投诉噪音后，责令Waymo停止夜间充电业务。该裁决反映了社区对自动驾驶汽车基础设施对住宅社区影响的日益增长的担忧。

title: Defcon's new badge is a security key you can see inside
summary: Defcon's latest conference badge features a removable security chip that attendees can inspect and extract for personal use beyond the event. The design emphasizes transparency and hands-on learning for the hacker community.
content: A removable chip lets hackers inspect their badge—and keep using it after Defcon.

zh.title: Defcon的新徽章是一个可以看到内部的安全密钥
zh.summary: Defcon最新的会议徽章配备了可拆卸的安全芯片，与会者可以检查和提取该芯片供活动外的个人使用。该设计强调了对黑客社区的透明度和动手学习。

title: How fruit flies chase invisible ribbons of smell to get to their source
summary: Fruit flies navigate to odor sources by tracking invisible plumes of smell through turbulent air using directional cues and memory. The research reveals how these insects employ sophisticated sensory mechanisms to locate food despite challenging environmental conditions.
content: Tracking smells in turbulent air takes a keen sense of direction and sharp memory.

zh.title: 果蝇如何追踪隐形的气味丝带到达其源头
zh.summary: 果蝇通过在湍流空气中追踪隐形的气味羽流，利用方向线索和记忆导航到气味源。该研究揭示了这些昆虫如何利用复杂的感觉机制在具有挑战性的环境条件下定位食物。
